title: Hr'a'cknir Bracers

sources.title: Telekinesis
markers: The limit to once per turn is not applied

summary: Gain +1 Strength saves, quicker Mage Hand casting and Telekinesis once per Short Rest.

fields.Quickened Mage Hand: If you know Mage Hand, you can cast it as a Bonus Action. The bracers do not teach the cantrip. The standard version summons an object-manipulating hand within 60 ft for 10 turns, once per Short Rest.
fields.Telekinesis: Action once per Short Rest. Throw a creature or object up to 60 ft. A creature resists with Strength against your spell save DC. Concentrate for up to 10 turns to recast without a spell slot. A successful initial creature save prevents recasts; successful saves on later casts do not end concentration. Heavier objects can deal more impact damage.
fields.Reported behavior: The source reports the stated once-per-turn recast restriction is not enforced. Throwing a burning object at a target can ignite the caster.
fields.Acquisition: Worn by Ch’r’ai Tska’an near the bridge out of Reithwin.

changes: Added native BG3 gameplay details with pinned item and linked rules evidence. Reconciled applicable action, condition, and variant details against pinned rules.
